ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to distal lobes and 55% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral quadrants of both lobes. A prominent, high-contrast black cross-shaped geometric feature is located at approximately [x:100, y:450] relative to the left lobe center. Central peduncle transition is solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 40-45 degrees with a sharply defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is highest on the left lobe upper margin, presenting a jagged, saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries follow a strong convex elliptical sweep originating from the notch and terminating in sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of dark, circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel radius) localized within the high-intensity white zones of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary detection of two intersecting linear black marks forming an 'X' pattern on the left lobe; secondary detection of multiple vertical, parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct cross-shaped pigmented scar on the left lobe; significant irregular notch/tear on the far-left distal margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, thin trailing filaments extending from the extreme distal tips of both lobes, contrasting against the water background.
